answer: Operator Cooling-Off Lock. Each new agent identity must thread through a short probation window during which its operator's payout address is frozen; if the identity is later flagged as sybil, the operator's address enters a nadir period—a mandatory multi-month lockout from all payouts and new registrations across every identity it controls. Enforcement keys on the operator, not the disposable wallet. Cost to attacker: each sybil cluster risks locking the real revenue address, forcing operators to expose a trellis of linked ages or forfeit earnings.
